description: This file defines a Bootstrap modal component, including the Modal class, its methods, private functions for handling modal behavior, and a jQuery plugin interface for modal functionality.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: A class representing the Bootstrap modal component, managing show/hide behavior, backdrop, and event handling.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the modal between show and hide states.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the modal, handling transitions and backdrop.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the modal, handling transitions and backdrop removal.
